description: In-app updates. Split out of `default` because these two plugins are compiled ONLY on desktop — Cargo.toml gates them behind cfg(not(any(target_os = "android", target_os = "ios"))) since tauri-plugin-updater has no Android support. A capability with no `platforms` key applies to every target, so leaving these in `default` makes the Android build fail on a permission whose plugin was never compiled into it. `default` cannot simply be scoped instead: fs, notification and os in there are needed on Android too.
